headline: Apple Music hides a playable original iPod as a 25th-anniversary Easter egg
summary: Apple added a hidden Easter egg to Apple Music's 404 page: a virtual recreation of the original iPod, playable with early-2000s music, which users spotted on social media on Friday. Engadget tied the feature to the iPod's 25th anniversary.

claims.statement: Apple added a hidden Easter egg on Apple Music's 404 page: a virtual recreation of the original iPod, playable with early-2000s music.

sources.quote: Apple revives the original iPod as an Apple Music easter egg
If you've been feeling nostalgic for your old iPod, you can head over to Apple Music's 404 page to play music on a virtual recreation of the first-generation iPod.

claims.statement: The hidden iPod recreation was spotted by users on social media on Friday.
